# Review speed and accuracy: approving and rejecting AI-written changes
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #151, sha256:ee36efd14124c72a1fcc28040fdefc7b7658c28c5f0b7c737d2f40651c3633a2). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** data (a pre-registered study)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** Steve's purpose-level ruling relayed by Dispatch, 2026-10-28 (VISION ruling 7: Phrase is not meant to beat C#; it solves the problems of AI-written code being unaccountable, unverifiable at the speed it is written, with intent vanishing with the prompt) and Decider D99 (Codex Yes, Grok Support-it). The head-to-head benchmark stays published as context and is not the success measure.
- **Depends on:** 134
- **Story:** As Steve, I want to know how fast and how accurately a reviewer approves correct AI-written changes and rejects subtly wrong ones in each form, so that I can see whether Phrase makes AI-written code reviewable.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a design Decider written before any row, When it is read, Then it fixes the change set (some correct, some subtly wrong, with a sealed answer key), the review forms, the reviewers and versions, how time and tokens are measured, the blinding and randomization of order, the scoring (approve-wrong and reject-correct rates) and the Goodhart guard
  2. Given the changes in each form, When a reviewer decides, Then each row records form, change, decision, correctness, time and tokens spent
  3. Given the rows, When summarized, Then speed is reported with accuracy (never alone), per form, with its uncertainty and no verdict beyond the pre-registered sentence

## Context

- Goodhart guard (D99): the design Decider fixes before any row the sample, the planted cases or mutants, the scoring rubric, timing and blinding or randomization, the model and reviewer versions and matched proof levels; mutant operators and review cases are frozen and sealed from the authors who tune Phrase; speed is reported with accuracy; the success sentence is written first.
- Model reviewers now; human reviewers later as their own card.
